findings.analytical_rationale: The HPLC module captures genuine chromatographic phenomena: mobile phase polarity shifts, gradient delay/dwell effects, Van Deemter plate height minimization, column stationary phase selectivity (C18 vs C8 vs Phenyl vs HILIC), and system suitability metrics (USP tailing, resolution, theoretical plates).
missing_analytical_variables: Secondary chemical equilibria (solute ionization vs mobile phase pH via Henderson-Hasselbalch)
Dwell volume (gradient delay volume V_D) distortion on early-eluting peaks
Sample solvent mismatch (viscous fingering / breakthrough from injection solvent stronger than initial mobile phase)
Column temperature axial and radial thermal gradients caused by frictional heating at high pressures
findings.required_experimental_validation: Direct chromatographic comparison against standard analytical test mixtures (e.g., Uracil + Acetophenone + Benzene + Toluene + Naphthalene on Agilent Eclipse Plus C18, 4.6 x 150 mm, 5 um) across 5 isocratic mobile phase compositions (40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80% ACN) and 3 linear gradient ramps.
findings.publication_opportunity: High in chemical education and analytical pedagogy journals (Journal of Chemical Education, Computer Applications in Engineering Education), or specialized chromatographic modeling venues if coupled with real experimental retention calibration data.
